disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual personal use of narcotic drugs or other addiction-forming/sustaining drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual personal use of narcotic drugs, or any other drug having addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual use of intoxicating liquors to an extent affecting professional competency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual use of intoxicating liquors, or any beverage, to an extent which affects professional competency.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administering, dispensing or prescribing narcotic or controlled drugs outside legitimate professional practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Administering, dispensing or prescribing any narcotic drug, or any other drug having addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability otherwise than in the course of legitimate professional practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of violation of any federal or state law regulating possession, distribution or use of narcotic or controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of violation of any federal or state law regulating the possession, distribution or use of any narcotic drug or any drug considered a controlled substance under state or federal law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procuring, attempting to procure, or aiding in an abortion that is not medically indicated
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Procuring, or attempting to procure, or aiding in, an abortion that is not medically indicated.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or misdemeanor involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony or misdemeanor involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining or attempting to obtain a license by fraud or deception
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining or attempting to obtain a license by fraud or deception.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional conduct including practicing under false name, assisting unlicensed persons, flamboyant claims, dishonorable conduct, fraudulent fee collection, false documents, or failure to identify school of practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unprofessional conduct, which includes, but is not limited to: (a) Practicing medicine under a false or assumed name or impersonating another practitioner, living or dead.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusal, revocation, suspension or other restriction of a license by another state's licensing authority
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The refusal of a licensing authority of another state or jurisdiction to issue or renew a license, permit or certificate to practice medicine in that jurisdiction or the revocation, suspension or other restriction imposed on a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Surrender of license or medical staff membership while under disciplinary investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Surrender of a license or authorization to practice medicine in another state or jurisdiction or surrender of membership on any medical staff or in any medical or professional association or society while under disciplinary investigation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Final sanctions imposed by HHS Office of Inspector General based on incompetency, gross misconduct or failure to meet professional standards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Final sanctions imposed by the United States Department of Health and Human Services, Office of Inspector General or any successor federal agency or office, based upon a finding of incompetency, gross misconduct or failure to meet professionally recognized standards of health care

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to furnish the board, its investigators or representatives legally requested information
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to furnish the board, its investigators or representatives information legally requested by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of the Medical Practice Act or board rules, orders, stipulations or agreements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any provision(s) of the Medical Practice Act or the rules and regulations of the board or of any order, stipulation or agreement with the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of provisions relating to deceptive advertisement by health care practitioners
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation(s) of the provisions of Sections 41-121-1 through 41-121-9 relating to deceptive advertisement by health care practitioners.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing or inducing an abortion in violation of statutory provisions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing or inducing an abortion on a woman in violation of any provision of Sections 41-41-131 through 41-41-145.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing an abortion after determining the unborn individual has a detectable fetal heartbeat
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing an abortion on a pregnant woman after determining that the unborn human individual that the pregnant woman is carrying has a detectable fetal heartbeat as provided in Section 41-41-34.1.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Professional incompetency in the practice of medicine or surgery
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Professional incompetency in the practice of medicine or surgery

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplinary action by peers within professional medical associations or by a licensed hospital or medical staff
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having disciplinary action taken by his peers within any professional medical association or society, whether any such association or society is local, regional, state or national in scope, or being disciplined by a licensed hospital or medical staff of said hospital

disciplinary_grounds.description: Mental illness rendering physician unable to practice with reasonable skill or safety
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Mental illness

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being out of compliance with an order for support

definition_quote.value: The practice of medicine shall mean to suggest, recommend, prescribe, or direct for the use of any person, any drug, medicine, appliance, or other agency, whether material or not material, for the cure, relief, or palliation of any ailment or disease of the mind or body, or for the cure or relief of any wound or fracture or other bodily injury or deformity, or the practice of obstetrics or midwifery, after having received, or with the intent of receiving therefor, either directly or indirectly, any bonus, gift, profit or compensation

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Graduates of foreign medical colleges approved by the National Educational Council for Foreign Medical Graduates may receive a limited institutional license for practice in state institutions only, for up to 5 years (with possible waiver). They must apply through the board, obtain recommendations from local medical society and board of trustees, and the board may issue a limited license if a majority of recommendations are favorable. Full license may be granted to a foreign graduate who held an institutional license for 29 years and passed the clinical competency part of the Flex Examination.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: The State Board of Medical Licensure is hereby authorized and empowered to grant limited institutional license for the practice of medicine in state institutions to graduates of foreign medical colleges approved by the National Educational Council for Foreign Medical Graduates or its successor

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: A physician outside Mississippi may render a medical opinion or treatment via telemedicine without a Mississippi license only if the evaluation is requested by a Mississippi-licensed physician who has already established a doctor/patient relationship with the patient. Otherwise, a full Mississippi license is required.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: The requirement of licensure as set forth in subsection (2) above shall not be required where the evaluation, treatment and/or the medical opinion to be rendered by a physician outside this state (a) is requested by a physician duly licensed to practice medicine in this state, and (b) the physician who has requested such evaluation, treatment and/or medical opinion has already established a doctor/patient relationship with the patient to be evaluated and/or treated.

telemedicine_license_available.quote: no person shall engage in the practice of medicine across state lines (telemedicine) in this state, hold himself out as qualified to do the same, or use any title, word or abbreviation to indicate to or induce others to believe that he is duly licensed to practice medicine across state lines in this state unless he has first obtained a license to do so from the State Board of Medical Licensure

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: The Interstate Medical Licensure Compact is enacted into law and entered into by this state with any and all states legally joining in the Compact in accordance with its terms

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: anybody taking action as set forth in this paragraph shall report such action to the board within thirty (30) days of its occurrence.

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: a portion of which fee shall be used to support a program to aid impaired physicians and osteopaths

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: If the state board of medical licensure has reasonable cause to believe that a physician licensed to practice medicine in this state is unable to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety to patients because of a condition described in Section 73-25-53, such board of medical licensure shall cause an examination of such physician to be made

investigational_drug_protection.quote: Except in cases of gross negligence or willful misconduct, civil immunity shall apply to any licensed physician or licensed pharmacist who prescribes or makes recommendation to an eligible patient regarding prescription for or treatment with an investigational drug, biological product or device under the provisions of Section 41-131-1, and the State Board of Medical Licensure and/or the State Board of Pharmacy, as the case may be, shall be prohibited from taking any adverse action against the license of such physician or pharmacist based solely on the physician's action under the provisions of Section 41-131-1.
